notes: Fixes the 500 error ('__PHP_Incomplete_Class') on Security Settings after clicking 'Refresh Tor list now' - the refresh timestamp was cached as a raw object, which the real database-backed cache can't reliably restore. Now stored as plain text instead, and any leftover bad value from before this fix is handled gracefully (shows 'Not fetched yet' instead of erroring) rather than needing manual cleanup - just click Refresh again after installing. No database update needed for this update.
